description.value: The Hilton Vancouver Downtown is a 207-room full-service hotel on Robson Street in central Vancouver, part of the global Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand. The concrete-and-glass building is wheelchair accessible and sits in the heart of the downtown core. It offers touring cyclists a well-located, full-service urban accommodation option with proximity to Vancouver's inner-city cycling routes.
